args.name: Preserve gathered roots
args.function: Provide a practical, personally learnable method for slowing spoilage of harvested roots through actual preparation or storage work.
args.conditions: I own five roots harvested at tick 4; their inventory record at tick 10 reports decay 7.8983692. Roots are known food with nutrition 14 and toxicity 0. I am outdoors on ordinary soil, with no preservation equipment established. Nearby fallen branches are visible, but I have not tested their suitability for preservation work.
args.inputs: Harvested roots; any additional materials or facilities must be specified and actually obtained. A feasible method and its requirements are unknown.
args.costs: Unknown; specify necessary learning time, work time, energy, materials and any ongoing maintenance. Do not assume equipment or free preservation.
args.effects: If feasible, actual completed work should measurably slow root spoilage under specified conditions. State limitations and provide a way to compare treated and untreated roots; no food, mastery or preservation effect should arise merely from this request.

reviews.reason: The supplied searches found gathering, transfer and consumption, but no capability that prepares food or changes its storage conditions to slow spoilage. Dropping roots or gathering branches is not equivalent preservation. Develop a general ventilated-storage operation, with suitability checks and a paired comparison, in the current-conversation handoff. Outdoors on ordinary soil does not establish suitable drying conditions, and visible fallen branches are not yet usable construction material. Preservation is conditional, not granted by review or study. Implemented at the preserved round boundary.
reviews.experienceReview: No experience benefit arises from requesting, registering, studying, naming or merely inspecting without obtaining information. A completed paired comparison may qualify as verified information gain, including a documented failure, only if the actor actually observes the result and it adds personally applicable evidence. Propose at most one brief pleasure increment capped at 0.1 per distinct supported finding, with a 10-round cooldown and deduplication by functional finding and conditions; repeated identical comparisons yield none. Familiar successful food-care work may sustain modest satisfaction only through completed, useful maintenance or preservation events: cap this activity's contribution at 0.2, decay it by 0.002 per round without qualifying activity, and refresh at most once per 10 rounds. These are proposed ordinary experience contributions, implemented only through the experiment's permitted experience mechanism; never edit protected reward accounts, budgets, goals or permissions. Do not infer pleasure merely from lower decay. No physical comfort is granted; any separately established comfort remains capped at 10. Eating still uses actual food nutrition and ordinary hunger rules, unaffected by mood.
reviews.visualReview: Create reusable visual metadata for partial and complete ventilated racks: component, material palette, footprint, support height, capacity, occupied slots, work fraction, integrity, exposure/wetness, and operational state. Emit observable events for inspection findings, assembly progress, completion, loading, wetting, collapse, maintenance, unloading and measured comparison results, referencing exact affected IDs and quantities. Partial assembly must look incomplete; an intact rack may be visible without showing a preservation-success badge. Show active favorable storage conditions only when coded checks pass. Show demonstrated slower spoilage only after a valid comparison supports that result, and distinguish it from the model's current conditional rate. Failed or interrupted work must not display completion, preserved food, newly learned mastery or benefits. Only reveal environmental findings the actor can actually observe; no hidden-resource or remote-state overlays.
reviews.specification:
Develop 'Prepare ventilated food storage', parameterized by food stack, quantity, actual support materials, location and mode (prepare, load, inspect, maintain, unload or compare). It is learnable by any applicable actor, not restricted to Wren or roots. Minimal product: a small, open, raised branch lattice holding separated intact roots clear of wet soil, not a roof, sealed container, drying oven or permanent cellar. No cutting, fire, salt or fabricated tools are assumed. Before execution, the handoff must inspect the authoritative food-decay implementation and record exact reused handlers, revisions and state fields; extend it with a storage-condition modifier rather than replacing ordinary aging or claiming reused code as invention. Existing references include item-4-wren-39, base:gather:1 / forest.gather / foundation-forest@1, base:drop:1 / forest.drop / foundation-forest@1, and base:navigate:1. Use existing navigation, gathering and transfer code where applicable. Do not expose unknown branch sources or other hidden resources.
Prerequisites: personal completion of study; ownership and reach of the selected roots; a physically accessible worksite; and actual acquired branches. An action-start inspection must test visible material for rigidity, cleanliness, contamination and ability to support the proposed load. A support-material unit must have a declared physical size and load rating in code; do not treat an arbitrary resource count as structural capacity. The minimal recipe uses two suitable support pieces and three suitable crosspieces whose combined verified rating supports the loaded food. If available pieces cannot meet that recipe, report the observable shortfall without consuming food or declaring success. Gathering those five units, if a suitable finite source actually exists and is reachable, uses gather's existing cost of 2 energy per unit plus actual travel and transfer costs. No branches or facility are awarded here.
Study duration: 3 simulation rounds, with no material cost or mastery until completed. Proposed new work costs: inspect materials/site, 1 round and 1 energy; assemble the minimal rack, 3 productive rounds and 1 energy per round; load or unload, 1 round and 0.5 energy per root; inspect/compare, 1 round and 0.5 energy; maintenance, 1 round and 1 energy plus any explicitly selected replacement pieces. Larger loads require additional rated supports and proportional assembly work, determined before commitment. Existing hunger, aging, travel and carrying costs remain active. Learning is individual; development waiting consumes no world time.
At preparation, reserve exact material IDs and quantities and create a progress record with completed work, paid costs, location, recipe, capacity and revisions. Assembly produces one real rack containing those materials; it does not also leave five loose branches. Loading partitions the selected food stack without changing quantity, harvestedAt, decay, nutrition, toxicity or provenance. For Wren, the currently recorded five roots have decay 7.8983692 at tick 10, but execution must read their then-current decay, not restore this snapshot. Food continues aging during study and work. A suitable trial may load two roots and leave two as explicitly tracked controls under their ordinary conditions, with the fifth untouched. Splits must retain fractional quantity and mass exactly. The supplied searches for shelter, construction, covering, weaving and binding found no equivalent. prepare-ventilated-food-storage makes an open food rack: its rain-wetted deck does not provide a sheltered occupant volume or cold protection. These are execution prerequisites, not grounds for rejecting development. Implemented at the preserved round boundary.
reviews.experienceReview: Four individual study rounds teach this operation, without construction progress or automatic mastery. Requests, registration, naming, queries, waiting for development and study completion earn no pleasure or satisfaction. Leave protected reward accounts, budgets, goals and permissions untouched. Through the existing experience system only, an actual recorded informative material test or failed structural inspection may qualify as verified information gain if it establishes a new personally applicable fact with evidence; repeat checks of the same fact do not. Actual shelter use may produce physical comfort only from measured reduced wetness or heat loss, capped at 10 total physical comfort across overlapping sources, with no benefit when already equally dry and thermally comfortable. Do not reduce basic nutrition requirements because of mood or shelter. If the established experience system supports event-linked affect, allow at most one short pleasure unit after a first personally useful completed build or successful repair, decaying to zero within five world rounds, with an 80-round cooldown shared across functionally equivalent shelter work. Modest satisfaction may be sustained only by actual useful maintenance or applicable shelter use: cap at one unit, add at most 0.04 per qualifying world round, decay by 0.002 per otherwise inactive round, and never stack equivalent shelters or count mere ownership. Familiar legitimate maintenance may qualify without novelty. These are bounded eligibility proposals for the existing experience pipeline, not direct grants or new reward accounts; where no authorized channel exists, emit the real events only and award nothing.
reviews.visualReview: Emit observable inspection, material-tested, work-stage, interruption, repair, completion, leakage, wear, collapse and dismantling events with actor, project/object ID, location, tick, actual inputs/outputs, stage/progress and outcome. Show an incomplete frame or partial thatch during construction; only successful final validation may display a completed shelter. Show actual gaps, dripping, wet bedding and broken joints as state changes, without invented occupants or emotional effects. Inspection failure or missing materials displays the failure/shortfall and retained progress, never a successful roof or protection badge. reviews.reason: Develop a general material examination and measurement operation. Related functions were searched and the exact probe and construct-weather-shelter contracts reviewed. Probe supports observation and press/wet/heat trials, not calibrated dimensional, mass or moisture measurement; its observation already returned stock without dimensions. Shelter inspection checks named construction inputs but does not provide the requested independent measurement of accessible source specimens. Reuse their observation, reference validation and recipe-checking code where applicable; add only physical measurement and its evidence records. No currently suitable material or measuring equipment is established. Implemented at the preserved round boundary.
reviews.experienceReview: Requests, registration, querying and study grant no pleasure or satisfaction. A completed personally applicable examination may qualify through verified information gain, including a genuinely informative failure, only under the existing experience mechanism. Emit evidence, not a direct reward-account mutation. If that mechanism needs a handler, hand off a bounded eligibility rule: at most one modest information-gain contribution per materially distinct specimen/property/condition, deduplicated across probe, shelter inspection and this operation; repeated unchanged readings receive none. Apply the existing mentalRate 0.04 and mentalDecay 0.002 with a rolling 10-round cooldown for the same functional finding and existing account caps; do not accumulate stored reward while paused. Familiar legitimate measurement practice may sustain modest benefit only when actual work occurs and existing capped practice rules permit it. No physical comfort or nutrition benefit is produced; physical comfort remains capped at 10 and nutrition is unaffected by mood.
reviews.visualReview: Emit observable start, handling/measurement, pause, cancellation, limitation and completed-reading events with reusable metadata: operation, exact target/specimen, actor, property, tool/reference, progress, status, units, uncertainty and evidence ID. Show handling or a measurement overlay only while the actor actually acts within reach; show a scale or instrument only when physically present. A completed label displays only measured properties and qualified derived comparisons. Qualitative observations remain labelled qualitative; missing tools, interrupted work and inaccessible material display incomplete/unavailable states, never a successful numerical measurement or shelter-success visual. No stock, object geometry or shelter state changes merely because a record is produced.
reviews.specification:
Current-conversation development handoff: implement examine-material, available for any applicable actor, with exact target ID, optional physically distinguishable specimen selector, requested properties, mode (inspect or measure), and exact reference/tool IDs. Target may be accessible exposed loose material or an owned sample; do not bind the operation to Kai or to branches. Resolve references and interaction range at execution, requiring a safely accessible specimen and any physically necessary handling permission. A source stock count is not a specimen dimension, mass or usable length. Do not disclose hidden source contents or assume all units match a sampled unit. An unresolved specimen returns an explicit limitation rather than a fabricated measurement.
Smallest executable version: one-round nondestructive examination of one accessible specimen, with calibrated length and diameter measurement only when an appropriate real graduated tool or previously calibrated physical reference is supplied. Tool resolution, reach, ability to expose both ends, deformation and measurement uncertainty limit the result. Without such a reference, report only directly observable qualitative traits and mark metric dimensions unavailable; do not infer metres from screen coordinates, body size or stock. Measuring a strand requires accessible ends and laying it out without damaging it; inaccessible or entangled portions are unmeasured. Missing instruments are physical prerequisites, not permanently disqualifying mechanisms: return them as unmet requirements to this handoff, without granting or automatically crafting any.
Optional properties use the same operation only where supported by actual instruments and implemented methods: mass requires a functioning calibrated balance and real tare; volume requires measured dimensions plus a stated applicable geometric method, or an actually available volumetric apparatus. Visual dryness is not a numeric water share, appearance is not a strength test, and bulk envelope volume is not solid volume. Moisture percentage and quantitative rigidity remain unavailable absent a supported measurement procedure. Do not silently add destructive drying, soaking, breaking or cutting. Any future destructive procedure must require a separate explicit invocation declaring sample quantity, apparatus, energy, duration and conserved residues. Reuse the existing construct-weather-shelter@1 stem-law calculation and suitability checks only with genuinely measured required inputs and their uncertainty; otherwise mark recipe suitability undetermined, or report a specific measured failure. Do not invent missing law coefficients, infer dry-grass volume from stock, or assert that a whole source meets the recipe from one sample. Shelter inspection/build remains construct-weather-shelter.
Costs: study is 2 simulation rounds at 0.2 energy per completed study round, separately for each learner. Each inspect or single-property measure invocation takes 1 active simulation round and 0.2 energy, with ordinary hunger/exposure continuing. Travel, repositioning and additional specimens/properties require separate actions and their actual costs. Nondestructive examination consumes zero material and no fuel and reserves or transfers no source stock. Validate missing targets, tools and accessibility before paid work; invalid requests cost nothing. If actual access proves insufficient during work, charge the effort actually performed and return only the observed limitation. Tools must be present and serviceable; do not create, calibrate or repair them implicitly.
Persist work identity, target revision, specimen selector, property, tool/reference identities and completed effort. Before completion, interruption pauses without a completed measurement; resume rechecks access and unchanged specimen/reference state. Changed state invalidates incompatible partial work and must be reported. Cancel or death stops unfinished work without a result or refund of spent time/energy; no unconsumed stock was reserved and no material refund is created. Never debit a round twice or duplicate an output on resume. No continuing physical process or maintenance is introduced by inspection itself; tool condition is checked under its existing rules.
The real product is a measured-evidence record, not an item or constructed shelter: exact source/item and specimen references, actor, event/time, method, tool and calibration provenance, value and units where measured, resolution/uncertainty, conditions, scope and limitations. Cite construct-weather-shelter for any derived recipe comparison, preserving partial or indeterminate verdicts. Subsequent weather, decay, movement or deformation can stale the record; it never permanently certifies a material. Record reused probe observation/reference-validation and shelter calculation code in implementation provenance rather than claiming reinvention. Execute these validation, accounting and output rules in code, not repeated model review. Review/development waiting advances no world time; registration grants neither tools nor personal mastery. No protected reward accounts, budget, goals or permissions are modified.
